unique_original_math: Let a step have dx,dy in {-1,0,1}. Its Euclidean length is at least dx+(sqrt(2)-1)*(-dy) for a net journey right/down; this linear lower bound holds for every horizontal, vertical and diagonal directed step.
Summing from (0,2) to (4,0) gives 4+2(sqrt2-1)=2+2sqrt2. Two down-right cell diagonals and two horizontal unit edges attain it. Thus the minimum value is uniquely C.

Both dashed additions are expressly permitted cell diagonals. Their red/blue L alternatives cost2, while a diagonal costs sqrt2. Color grouping compares displacement, never declares equal travel lengths. Grid sizes, Start and Finish remain unchanged.
